purpose: Make the telos, dreams, anti-goals, and future-session handoff explicit before further scaling.
canonical_one_sentence: Build the durable, source-backed memory of how knowledge fails, corrects, travels, lags, revives, and teaches.

why_the_four_seed_corpora_belong_togethe.role: Preserves the denominator of attempts, not merely successful published claims.
Tests whether claims survive repeated, changed, adversarial, or scaled observation.
Shows empirical disconfirmation in built systems, where consequences, warnings, institutions, and material constraints become visible.
Explains transmission: why claims, methods, overstatements, doubts, and corrections moved through people, labs, scenes, textbooks, regulators, and tools.

foundation_laws.name: source_before_story
foundation_laws.rule: A beautiful explanatory story is downstream of sources, claims, and status history.

foundation_laws.name: status_motion_before_verdict
foundation_laws.rule: Claims usually need trajectories: proposed, adopted, challenged, narrowed, reversed, revived, dormant, or practice-persistent.

foundation_laws.name: denominator_before_numerator
foundation_laws.rule: Whenever possible, compare visible successes to the attempted, registered, unpublished, abandoned, or corrected denominator.

foundation_laws.name: pattern_records_must_be_earned
foundation_laws.rule: A pattern is not an insight-shaped anecdote; it is earned by multiple records, negative controls, counterexamples, and rollback triggers.

foundation_laws.name: correction_surface_is_a_record
foundation_laws.rule: Registries, accident boards, reporting systems, guidelines, databases, inquiries, and recommendation trackers deserve records because they make correction possible.

foundation_laws.name: practice_is_not_literature
foundation_laws.rule: A claim can die in papers and live in hospitals, classrooms, codebases, policy, or popular belief. Track both.

foundation_laws.name: transmission_is_evidence_sensitive
foundation_laws.rule: Influence, reaction, lineage, citation, co-presence, and institutional inheritance are different edges; do not treat them as the same.

foundation_laws.name: dignity_before_drama
foundation_laws.rule: The cube is not a wall of shame. It should explain systems, incentives, uncertainty, responsibility, and hindsight bias without flattening people into villains.

foundation_laws.name: open_future
foundation_laws.rule: Schemas are scaffolds. Future sessions may split, merge, or replace record types if they preserve source, claim, status, ethics, and receipt discipline.

foundation_laws.name: resumption_is_a_design_surface
foundation_laws.rule: A 10k+ revision cube must be easy to reopen. Every revision should leave enough context for a future worker to resume without guessing.

anti_goals: Do not become a trivia database of famous mistakes.
Do not become an anti-science or anti-expertise grievance engine.
Do not become a static verdict archive that cannot represent revival or narrowing.
Do not become a misconduct database; fraud is only one small subtype of epistemic failure.
Do not become a single-discipline metascience project that ignores engineering, practice, software, or genealogy.
Do not become a schema cult. The forms exist to protect truthfulness and memory, not to suppress new kinds of records.
north_star_questions: What was tried, and what happened?
What did the visible literature hide or overrepresent?
What claim changed status, when, and why?
What warning existed before the failure, and why did it not become action?
What correction surface eventually made the problem visible?
Where did the literature update but practice, textbooks, policy, or public belief lag?
Which ideas, methods, errors, and corrections traveled through which people, institutions, conferences, tools, or lineages?
What recurring pattern is visible across domains, and what counterexamples prevent overclaim?
What would a young researcher, engineer, journalist, policymaker, educator, or AI model avoid repeating after reading this?
current_foundation_state: The cube has enough cross-lane records to justify a foundation pullback, but not enough review depth, negative controls, or source permanence to treat any pattern as mature.
